description: §23.2/§23.6 E-FOREIGN-003 — a library file (`lib.scrml`: an `export function`, NO `<program>`) with a bound inline value-returning `_={ 1 + 1 }=` foreign block but NO `<foreign lang=… />` declaration, imported by a `<program>` that has no `lang=` either. The admitted (value-returning, in a `function` body) block has no `lang=` to resolve, so it fires E-FOREIGN-003 (type-system.ts checkForeignBlocks) per §23.2.1/§23.6. S478: the library moved into an aux file imported by a `<program>` entry (an entry file holds a `<program>`), and `export fn` became `export function` (§23.2.4: the inline form is "in a server `function` body" — "NOT `fn`/pure helpers", the S471 correction of the §23.6 examples), so the case asserts the language rule alone.
